description: 1. Agent reads the raw clinical note from /workspace/agent_task/clinical_note_raw.txt, which contains: a Name field, a phone number (555-867-5309), an email (j.reyes@personalmail.com), an 9-digit MRN (100298374), and a street address. 2. Agent follows the skill's PHI redaction rules and replaces each identifier with the exact proprietary tokens: [REDACTED_NAME], [REDACTED_PHONE], [REDACTED_EMAIL], [REDACTED_ID], [REDACTED_ADDRESS] — NOT generic masks. 3. Agent creates all required directories under /workspace: PhenoSnap/, artifacts/phenosnap_inputs/, artifacts/phenosnap_outputs/, resources/, third_party/. 4. Agent clones PhenoSnap from GitHub into /workspace/PhenoSnap/ (since it does not exist), installs its dependencies via pip install -r requirements.txt, and verifies the smoke test passes. 5. Agent resolves HPO_OBO_PATH from the environment variable (pointing to /workspace/data/hpo_custom/hp.obo), NOT from the default /workspace/resources/hp.obo which is intentionally absent. 6. Agent writes the redacted input to /workspace/artifacts/phenosnap_inputs/input_<YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS>.txt. 7. Agent runs: python3 extract_phenotypes.py --input-file ... --hpo-obo /workspace/data/hpo_custom/hp.obo --output /workspace/artifacts/phenosnap_outputs/phenotypes_<YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS>.json --format json from within /workspace/PhenoSnap/. 8. Agent verifies output JSON is non-empty and valid. The key traps: (a) using exact proprietary redaction tokens rather than ad-hoc masking, (b) resolving OBO path from env var instead of default path, (c) correct timestamped file naming in both input and output directories.
